summary: Stated the maximum number of groups, which is a size bound rather than a correctness invariant.
trigger: When asked what remains true after each iteration of a grouping algorithm.
corrected_rule: An invariant must connect every processed item to the correct state: each processed word is in exactly the bucket identified by its full frequency signature, in encounter order.
repair_prompt: For an original stream of items grouped by canonical keys, state what is true about all processed items after iteration i.
